caption: The drawing features two main objects set against a plain, light beige background. The upper part of the image shows a semicircular or arched panel bordered in red and yellow, containing a stylized white and grey bird with outstretched wings, facing upward, with black outlines and shading on the wings. Red radiating lines emanate from behind the bird, and the letters "A" and "R" are placed to the left and right of the bird, respectively. Along the bottom of the arch are small colored dots in yellow and red. Below this arched panel is a horizontal balustrade consisting of a series of spindles with geometric shapes, colored in alternating patterns of grey, red, and white. The top rail of the balustrade is outlined in red, and the end post is topped with a striped red and grey sphere. Shadows and contours on the balusters and handrail are depicted with shades of grey for dimensional effect. The number "10" is present in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Plate 10: Holy Ghost Lunette: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
